summary: The rendered output captures some core text fields correctly, but it has several major fidelity issues: missing logo and QR placeholders, missing central watermark, missing recipient campus line, duplicated body text, missing footer information, and incomplete/misplaced seal/stamp representation. Overall it does not faithfully reproduce the source document.
matches_well: Main campus name, phone number, reference number, date, address, subject, signatory name, and signatory designation are largely captured.
English labels replacing Nepali labels are acceptable and mostly used consistently.
The general document type and core letter structure are recognizable: header, reference/date, recipient, subject, body, signature block, and copy section.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has a prominent triangular Tribhuvan University logo at the upper left, while the university name appears centered above the campus name.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The university logo/crest is not represented; the rendered output instead places the text 'त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय / Tribhuvan University' at the top-left.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has 'त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय / Tribhuvan University' centered above the main campus name, with the logo at left and phone/QR at right.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The university name is positioned at the upper left and the header layout is simplified/rearranged.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source contains a QR code near the top-right area below the phone number.
The source contains a round blue office seal/stamp centered below/over the campus header area, not as far right as in the rendered output.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: A circular placeholder labeled 'Round Office Seal' is present, but it is placed too far right and overlaps the main title area.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has a large faint clock-tower/watermark graphic running down the center of the page behind the letter text.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The central tower/watermark graphic is absent.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source recipient block contains three lines: 'श्री ज्योति कुमारी भट्ट जोशी', 'समाजशास्त्र विभाग', and 'त्रि-चन्द्र बहुमुखी क्याम्पस ।'
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The recipient line reads 'श्री ज्योति कुमारी भट्ट जोशी समाजशास्त्र विभाग' and does not include the campus line.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source states the appointment sentence once, ending as '... आंशिक शिक्षकमा नियुक्ति गरिएको छ ।' without the duplicated word.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The phrase appears as 'नियुक्ति गरिएको गरिएको छ ।', duplicating 'गरिएको'.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source has a handwritten signature plus a purple official stamp/seal below the signatory text reading campus-chief/campus information.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Only a signature placeholder and typed name/designation are shown; no separate office stamp/seal placeholder appears under the designation.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source copy section uses only Nepali numbering: '१)', '२)', '३)'.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Each item is numbered twice, e.g. '1) १)', '2) २)', '3) ३)'.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source footer includes 'Email: info@trc.tu.edu.np' at bottom-left and 'Website: https://trc.tu.edu.np' at bottom-right, separated by a horizontal footer line.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The email address, website URL, and footer line are missing.
